notes.title: Sophie: Starlight Whispers is now taking part in Steam China Showcase 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40586118/e9b326c6cdf2976264da22476d0bc595109efa18.jpg[/img]
Dear Players,

We're excited to participate in the Steam China Showcase hosted by Steam China!

We will be taking advantage of this fantastic opportunity to show case our upcoming game, Sophie: Starlight Whispers.

We are progressing well into the development. Though at this moment we don’t have a demo available, we are confident that we should have something for our followers in the near future! Please stay tuned! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1562140/Sophie_Starlight_Whispers/

Don't forget to add Sophie: Starlight Whispers to your wishlist if you're interested. It's a huge boost and support for us!

Make sure to check out the featured Steam Page for the Steam China Showcase as well! 

The Development Team
September 22, 2023

notes.title: Sophie: Starlight Whispers is now taking part in "BitSummit Let’sGo!!"!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40586118/c8a3d090ff69aa382ec441bb4eb6086df6b562b3.png[/img]
Dear Players,

We're excited to participate in the "BitSummit Let’sGo!!" event!

We will be taking advantage of this fantastic opportunity to show case our upcoming game, Sophie: Starlight Whispers. 

We are progressing well into the development. Though at this moment we don’t have a demo available, we are confident that we should have something for our followers in the near future!

Sophie: Startlight Whispers is a metroidvania genre game that features impressive and sophisticated level design as well as an excellent combat system. Its dramatic narrative revolves around Sophie, a girl with magical powers, and her adventures in the fantasy kingdom of Sharan.

Make sure to check out the featured Steam Page for the BitSummit Let’sGo!! as well! 

The Development Team
July 15, 2023

notes.title: Big update for the Sophie demo!
notes.content:
After much feedback and learning, today we release a new version of the Sophie demo, which is closer to what we want the full game to be. Improvements have been made to several aspects of the game: mechanics, UI, progression, dynamics, script, etc. We believe we have now achieved the quality we intend to maintain until the end of development to make sure our players have an immersive and fun experience! 

We hope you enjoy this new demo and send us your feedback – it's extremely important to us!

Special thanks to everyone who has been part of this journey with us!

notes.title: Let's Play Sophie
notes.content:
Let's play Sophie with the developers.

Come by and ask away as we go along this adventure.

Sophie is an adventure game with metroidvania elements that presents pixel art graphics and RPG characteristics driven by a deep, immersive, and dramatical narrative. The game tells the tale of Sophie, the main character: a strong-minded girl that ventures through the kingdom of Sharam, motivated by silhouettes she believes to be hallucinations.
